source_scope: Round 78: printed Chinese Chapters 1192–1201. Official QQ Reading chapter index and visible chapter previews were cross-checked against readable Qidian Bookresource excerpts. Cpxs123 mirror was used only for clean opening/title corroboration because its body contains unrelated scraped novels.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 心灵之匕，机械师神技！
outcomes: Three SS chest results: Fire God Greatsword to Nika, Mind Dagger bound to Sarah, X-Starry Firmament book held for Tong Chuchu.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 半神器套装，神之终结者！
outcomes: Five relics: Thunder Claw ×1, Ice Beast Heart ×2, Radiant Feather ×1, Wind Spirit Core ×1. Four relics and four held Legendary Hearts evolve four pets; Wind Spirit Core remains.
Netherlord · God’s Terminator level-200 six-piece semi-artifact set detailed; only chest armor/set effects are profiled here.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 回归！冲击神灵境界！
outcomes: Isabel, Nika and Allen each receive 600 Ice Dragon Crystals (30,000 Divine Power) and begin trials. Cao spends 60,000 Divine Power from a mixed source; split unknown.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 淬炼神性，登神前的考验！
outcomes: The three candidates reach 100% purity and begin trials; Light, Sacred Flame and Wind Godheads are incorporated/consumed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 大动乱，神灵混战！
outcomes: Awakened gods contest territory and worshippers; no protagonist-side loot confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 双极神主，成神试炼！
outcomes: Cao begins special trial; failure penalties and 36,500:1 trial time ratio stated.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 你真的了解寒冰…了解自己吗？
outcomes: Crystal Core quest item awarded; Crystal Element Mastery reaches god tier. Mirrored Ice trial begins.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 生死磨砺，最终阶段试炼开启！
outcomes: Mirror defeated; Ice Element Mastery reaches god tier; final ten-year balance trial begins.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 出关！混乱升级！
outcomes: Seven trial years pass; Cao develops coexistence between crystal/chaotic and ice forces. Divine occupation intensifies; no item receipt confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 四神耀世！肃清动乱！
outcomes: Cao Xing, Isabel, Nika and Allen ascend to divine status; territorial blessing underway; ten teams tasked to suppress gods. Two hostile lower gods captured, with no death/drop confirmed.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 号令诸神，违逆者杀无赦！
outcomes: Cao Xing’s roster is stated as three upper-god combatants and four more gods at peak midgod combat strength; the visible preview truncates before the full list.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 曹星的实力，碾压神灵！
outcomes: Cao’s cold force freezes the ancient vine god’s branches; no item receipt is visible in the accessible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 肃清开始，神陨如雨！
outcomes: The Flame Queen legion’s survivors witness Angelina being coerced; the visible preview also confirms several territory members were killed by a god’s divine威.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 镇杀！最后的混乱源头！
outcomes: Wind God Allen forms a consuming storm eye over the three-headed giant; no item receipt is visible in the accessible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 曹星VS毁灭之神，双规则现世！
outcomes: Valkyrie is struck away by the Destruction God as the gods react; chapter title confirms the dual-rule confrontation.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 斩杀毁灭之神，单挑无敌！
outcomes: Cao reveals that he can fuse two upper-god divinities; title confirms the Destruction God’s death, but drops are not confirmed in the preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 诸神臣服，乱世终结！
outcomes: Destruction God’s death is confirmed by blood-rain and the broken Destruction rule; title confirms the gods submit.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 清点战后收获，三大下位神技。
outcomes: Nika fuses the Holy Flame Godhead and transforms into Holy Flame Goddess; her advancement grants the visible stats/mastery/territory effects recorded under SX-1382. Three lower-god techniques are identified as self-created; their review begins next chapter.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 突破神灵奖励，超凡入圣！
outcomes: Nika’s named single-target divine skill and Isabel’s unnamed immortal-phoenix summon skill are partially described; third skill name/effect and exact coefficients are unavailable in the visible preview.

confirmed_outcomes.title: 组合神技——冰临天下！
outcomes: A self-select divine-technique chest offers 1 of 12 lower-god techniques across six classes. Cao selects Frost Mage, revealing two books; the preview ends before a final book choice.

unresolved_conflicts: Ch1163 shipment narration uses rounded quantities while altar system display reports exact consumption values; both are retained rather than normalized.
Ch1163 shows 97,164 new Hero promotions after 120,000 gather and 25,000 are held back; preserve displayed outcome.

Vietnamese edition chapter numbering diverges materially: Cơm Nguội and Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế Ch1162 title an ice-statue goddess story, while Xa Lộ Sách local Ch1162 is a split chapter on demigod breakthrough/return to territory. These titles do not establish the Chinese printed Ch1162 story contents or item facts.
No result is shown for the Abyss battle by Ch1171; no victory/loot should be inferred.
Ch1174 Alphonse death reward line is visibly truncated after explicit Guardian Godhead, shield and mace; additional drops remain unknown.
Ch1176 post-Nektar pseudogod reward labels are garbled/duplicated; retain uncertain attribution.
Ch1175 sword evolution requires 100 divine kills; do not equate that counter with SS mission 100/100.
Ch1181 staged divine-power fragment entries sum to 3,200, but subsequent narrative says 3,400; both are preserved pending source clarification.
Vietnamese edition-local chapter numbering/title arcs diverge from Bqquge printed Chinese numbering; no remapping inferred.
Ch1182 uses 心灵之匕 in the item panel and 心灵之刃 once in the binding prompt; treated as one identity with variant retained.
Ch1183 profiles the set chest armor and set effects, not the other five piece mechanics.
Ch1184 does not state the Ice Dragon Crystal/fragment split of Cao Xing’s 60,000 Divine Power expenditure.
Whether trial mastery abilities are separately transferable/permanent is not established; cataloged as outcomes rather than skill-book receipts.
Ch1191’s blessing effects and later fates/drops of captured lower gods remain unresolved.
Vietnamese edition mapping for printed Chinese Chapters 1182–1191 is unverified; no one-to-one local numbering inferred.

Chapter 1192–1201 third-party Cpxs123 mirror pages contain unrelated scraped novel paragraphs after the first opening lines; used only for matching headings/opening prose, never for later events or receipts.

Bookresource QQ/Qidian text mirror numbers the same post-battle chapters one below the QQ Reading index in this arc (e.g. “清点战后收获” as Ch1198 vs QQ Reading Ch1199). Crosswalk was made by exact title and story text, not by raw local number.

The QQ Reading text previews require app/login for continuation. The exact names/mechanics of the other self-created lower-god skill, the final chest selection, and any drops from the slain gods remain unverified.
